names.legendary: The Cap Collection That Filled a Shed

lore.common: Has crinkly edges that dig into thumbs when it is flicked.
lore.uncommon: Gets saved in a pocket for a collection and goes through the washing machine with a clank.
lore.rare: Flicks across a table so fast that it knocks over a whole row of dominoes.
lore.epic: Was collected by a child until the jar burst and caps rolled through the whole kitchen.
lore.legendary: Joined a collection so huge that the garden shed had to be emptied to hold it.

names.legendary: The Carafe That Never Ran Dry

lore.common: Sits on the restaurant table full of cold water, sweating little drops.
lore.uncommon: Glugs loudly whenever it is tipped, so every quiet dinner gets interrupted.
lore.rare: Pours so fast that every glass overflows before anyone can say stop.
lore.epic: Was knocked by an elbow at a busy dinner and soaked the whole bread basket.
lore.legendary: Refilled a hundred glasses at a summer wedding and was still half full at the end.

names.legendary: The Decanter Polished for Fifty Years

lore.common: Stands on the sideboard with a glass stopper that clinks when lifted.
lore.uncommon: Gets polished so often that nobody ever actually fills it with anything.
lore.rare: Catches the light so brightly that rainbows dance across the wallpaper.
lore.epic: Threw such bright rainbows across the dining room that the cat chased them all afternoon.
lore.legendary: Has been polished every Sunday for fifty years and has never held a single drink.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Went to Every Lesson

lore.common: Goes to school every day and comes home with a sticker on it.
lore.uncommon: Gets left in the car and is warm as bathwater by the afternoon.
lore.rare: Rolls under the bus seat at every stop and comes out at the other end.
lore.epic: Rolled under every seat on a school trip and was found in the coach driver's cab.
lore.legendary: Went to every single lesson for six years and was given its own leaving card.

names.legendary: The Flask That Warmed a Mountain

lore.common: Curves to fit a coat pocket and holds hot cocoa on cold walks.
lore.uncommon: Clinks against keys in the pocket so that everyone hears the walker coming.
lore.rare: Keeps cocoa so warm that it steams on the top of a snowy hill.
lore.epic: Shared hot cocoa with a whole hiking group on a frosty hill, and nobody's nose went blue.
lore.legendary: Warmed a whole mountain rescue team with cocoa on the coldest night of the year.

names.legendary: The Brew That Fizzed for a Week

lore.common: Fizzes gently in its bottle with a cloudy mystery floating inside.
lore.uncommon: Smells a little like vinegar, which surprises everyone who opens it.
lore.rare: Fizzes so strongly when opened that it sprays the ceiling.
lore.epic: Sprayed the whole fridge when it was opened, and the butter got a fizzy shower.
lore.legendary: Kept fizzing for a whole week after it was opened, and the family named it.

names.legendary: The Bottle Delivered at Dawn

lore.common: Waits on the doorstep in the morning with a foil top that birds love.
lore.uncommon: Gets its foil top pecked open by a bird before anyone is awake.
lore.rare: Has a creamy top so thick that the first pour comes out in a lump.
lore.epic: Was pecked open by every bird on the street, and they all had a creamy breakfast.
lore.legendary: Was delivered to the same doorstep every morning for forty years, even through the snow.

names.legendary: The Teat That Fed Four Babies

lore.common: Fits on the top of a baby's bottle and gets chewed instead of sucked.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost in the dishwasher and turns up in the cutlery basket.
lore.rare: Drips milk so slowly that the baby gets cross and wiggles.
lore.epic: Fed a baby so well at midnight that both baby and parent fell asleep at once.
lore.legendary: Fed four babies in one family, one after another, and was kept in a memory box.

names.legendary: The Lid Nobody Could Open

lore.common: Rattles on the bathroom shelf, kept up high where only grown-ups can reach it.
lore.uncommon: Has a cap that needs pushing and turning, which beats every grown-up too.
lore.rare: Hides its tiny instructions in writing so small that the whole family needs glasses to read it.
lore.epic: Defeated a whole family on a sniffly morning, until the youngest grown-up read the arrows.
lore.legendary: Has a lid so childproof that it once kept out a family of very clever raccoons.

names.legendary: The Cup That Survived the Highchair

lore.common: Has a spout and two handles and is thrown on the floor at every meal.
lore.uncommon: Leaks a little from the lid whenever it is turned upside down.
lore.rare: Gets dropped from the highchair so often that the dog waits under it.
lore.epic: Was hurled from the highchair across the kitchen and bounced into the dog's bowl.
lore.legendary: Was thrown, rolled and dropped a thousand times without spilling once.

names.legendary: The Cap That Squirted a Whole Team

lore.common: Pops up with a tug of the teeth and squirts water everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Gets chewed until it looks like a dog's toy.
lore.rare: Squirts so hard that the drinker gets water up the nose.
lore.epic: Squirted the whole football team at halftime, and they cheered for more.
lore.legendary: Squirted water so far at a sports day that it reached the finish line first.

names.legendary: The Can Recycled Nine Times

lore.common: Is a tall thin can that gets squashed flat before it goes in the recycling.
lore.uncommon: Has a ring pull that snaps off so it is impossible to open.
lore.rare: Gets crushed so flat that it slides under the recycling bin.
lore.epic: Was dropped in the recycling so loudly that the whole street woke up.
lore.legendary: Was recycled nine times and has been a bike, a ladder and a saucepan.

names.legendary: The Fizz That Lasted All Day

lore.common: Fizzes up the glass and tickles the nose with bubbles.
lore.uncommon: Makes its drinker burp at the worst possible moment.
lore.rare: Fizzes so much when poured that the glass overflows.
lore.epic: Made a whole party burp at once, and the music was drowned out.
lore.legendary: Stayed fizzy for a whole day after it was opened, which nobody can explain.

names.legendary: The Tin That Was Never Dented

lore.common: Sits in the cupboard with its label half torn off, so dinner is always a surprise.
lore.uncommon: Dents itself on the way home from the shop and then refuses to stack.
lore.rare: Gets stacked so high in the cupboard that it falls when anything is touched.
lore.epic: Fell from the top shelf and rolled all the way down the hall and out the door.
lore.legendary: Was carried home from the shop, stacked, moved and dropped, and never got a dent.

names.legendary: The Fizzy Drink That Never Went Flat

lore.common: Fizzes up when opened and makes a happy psst sound.
lore.uncommon: Sprays everywhere if it has been shaken in the bag on the way home.
lore.rare: Fizzes so wildly when opened that it soaks the person holding it.
lore.epic: Was shaken on a bus ride, and the opening soaked a whole row of seats.
lore.legendary: Made a burp so loud at a school lunch that the dinner ladies gave it a round of applause.

names.legendary: The Lobster That Took an Hour to Eat

lore.common: Sits on the plate with its claws pointing at whoever ordered it.
lore.uncommon: Needs special tools and a bib, and still splashes everyone.
lore.rare: Takes so long to crack that the rest of the table finishes dessert.
lore.epic: Took a whole hour to eat at a seaside dinner, and the waiter brought a second bib.
lore.legendary: Was so tricky to crack that a whole table worked together and cheered at the end.

names.legendary: The Mocktail With Three Umbrellas

lore.common: Has a tiny paper umbrella, a straw and a slice of orange balanced on the edge.
lore.uncommon: Loses its umbrella in the first gust of wind.
lore.rare: Makes anyone holding it feel like they're on holiday.
lore.epic: Was served at a garden party with so much fruit that it looked like a fruit salad.
lore.legendary: Had three umbrellas, two straws and a sparkler, and was the most famous mocktail on the beach.

names.legendary: The Glass That Was Always Full

lore.common: Sits by the bed at night and collects a little dust by the morning.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked over by a sleepy hand reaching for the alarm.
lore.rare: Is so clear that people forget it's there and knock it over.
lore.epic: Was knocked over in the night and soaked a whole book.
lore.legendary: Was kept full every night for so long that its owner never woke up thirsty.

names.legendary: The Stain That Was Finally Removed

lore.common: Is a dark red drink that grown-ups swirl in a glass at dinner.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a stain on the white tablecloth that never quite washes out.
lore.rare: Spills so easily that every white shirt in the room is in danger.
lore.epic: Was spilled at a dinner party, and the whole table spent an hour scrubbing.
lore.legendary: Left a stain that was finally removed after ten years, and the family threw a party.

names.legendary: The Hotdog That Was Longer Than Its Bun

lore.common: Has a sausage poking out of both ends of its bun.
lore.uncommon: Drips ketchup down its eater's arm.
lore.rare: Is so long that the bun only covers the middle.
lore.epic: Was eaten at a football match, and the ketchup went on the person in front.
lore.legendary: Was so long that it took three people and two buns to eat it.

names.legendary: The Jar That Fed a Fussy Baby

lore.common: Holds orange mush that babies love and spit out in equal amounts.
lore.uncommon: Gets its contents sprayed back at whoever is holding the spoon.
lore.rare: Turns every spoonful into an airplane flying into a tiny hangar.
lore.epic: Was fed to a baby who sneezed, and the whole kitchen was painted orange.
lore.legendary: Fed a fussy baby every single spoonful, and the parents cheered.

names.legendary: The Tiny Pearls That Cost a Fortune

lore.common: Is a little pile of tiny black pearls that pop on the tongue.
lore.uncommon: Comes in such a tiny tin that nobody gets more than a spoonful.
lore.rare: Pops so loudly in the mouth that its eater giggles every time.
lore.epic: Was served at a posh party, and every guest pulled the same face.
lore.legendary: Was so precious that it was served with a tiny golden spoon and a security guard.

names.legendary: The Jar That Caught Every Sneaker

lore.common: Sits on the counter with a lid that clatters loudly when lifted.
lore.uncommon: Is shaped like a smiling bear whose head comes off, which makes every snack feel a bit rude.
lore.rare: Makes such a loud noise when opened that everyone in the house hears.
lore.epic: Caught a whole family sneaking biscuits at midnight, one after another.
lore.legendary: Has caught every biscuit sneak in the house for twenty years, including the dog.

names.legendary: The Dip That Never Ran Out

lore.common: Sits in a bowl surrounded by crisps that dive in one after another.
lore.uncommon: Gets double-dipped by somebody who thinks nobody saw.
lore.rare: Is so popular at parties that the bowl is empty in minutes.
lore.epic: Was double-dipped so many times at a party that the bowl was full of crisp crumbs.
lore.legendary: Never ran out at a party, no matter how many crisps dived in.

names.legendary: The Honey That Never Went Off

lore.common: Drips off the spoon in a long golden thread that never wants to stop.
lore.uncommon: Sticks the spoon to the table so firmly that it has to be pulled off.
lore.rare: Drips so slowly that its pourer gets bored waiting.
lore.epic: Dripped all over breakfast, and the toast, the table and the cat got sticky.
lore.legendary: Was found in an old cupboard and was still perfect after a hundred years.

names.legendary: The Jar That Fed the Whole Hive

lore.common: Has a wooden dipper inside and a lid that sticks shut.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid so sticky that it takes two hands and hot water to open.
lore.rare: Attracts every wasp and bee in the garden the moment it's opened.
lore.epic: Was opened at a picnic, and every bee in the field came to visit.
lore.legendary: Held so much honey that the bees came round to check on it.

names.legendary: The Dip That Was Scooped Clean

lore.common: Sits in a swirl with a little pool of oil in the middle.
lore.uncommon: Gets a carrot stick broken off in it every time.
lore.rare: Is so creamy that carrot sticks disappear into it.
lore.epic: Was scooped so fast at a picnic that the bowl was licked clean.
lore.legendary: Was made so smooth at a picnic that a grandma said it was the best she'd ever had, and she'd had a lot.

names.legendary: The Jam That Won the Village Show

lore.common: Spreads on toast in a sweet sticky layer.
lore.uncommon: Drips off the edge of the toast and onto the shirt.
lore.rare: Is so sweet that it makes the whole kitchen sticky.
lore.epic: Dripped through a sandwich onto a picnic blanket, and the ants had a feast.
lore.legendary: Won the village show five years running, and the jar was put on display.

names.legendary: The Jar That Held Every Button

lore.common: Has a lid screwed on so tightly that nobody can open it.
lore.uncommon: Gets passed round the whole family until somebody strong opens it.
lore.rare: Holds onto its lid so tightly that it beats everyone in the house.
lore.epic: Defeated the whole family one evening, until the smallest child opened it first try.
lore.legendary: Has held buttons, marbles, coins and jam over fifty years, and is still everyone's favourite.

names.legendary: The Jar That Was Scraped Clean

lore.common: Is a creamy chocolate hazelnut spread that ends up on every face.
lore.uncommon: Gets eaten straight from the jar with a spoon when nobody is looking.
lore.rare: Is so tempting that the jar is empty before the bread runs out.
lore.epic: Was spread so thickly on toast that it was more spread than bread.
lore.legendary: Was scraped so clean that the jar shone like new, and the spoon was licked too.

names.legendary: The Jar That Stuck a Mouth Shut

lore.common: Spreads thick on bread and sticks to the roof of the mouth.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the knife so firmly that it needs to be licked off.
lore.rare: Glues its eater's mouth so firmly that they can't talk for a minute.
lore.epic: Was spread so thickly at breakfast that nobody could talk until lunch.
lore.legendary: Stuck a mouth shut so firmly that its owner had to write notes all morning.

names.legendary: The Jar That Smelled Like a Deli

lore.common: Holds pickles floating in vinegar and a lid that won't open.
lore.uncommon: Splashes vinegar on whoever finally opens it.
lore.rare: Smells so strong when opened that the whole kitchen pulls a face.
lore.epic: Splashed vinegar all over a picnic, and the sandwiches tasted of pickles.
lore.legendary: Smelled so much like a sandwich shop that people came in asking to order.

names.legendary: The Salsa That Made Everyone Cry

lore.common: Is a bowl of chopped tomatoes, onions and a little bit of chilli.
lore.uncommon: Drips red juice down every tortilla chip and onto the tablecloth.
lore.rare: Sneaks a chunk of chilli onto the one chip that the bravest person didn't check.
lore.epic: Made a whole table cry at a party, and they all asked for the recipe.
lore.legendary: Was so spicy that the whole party cried happy tears and asked for a second bowl.

names.legendary: The Jar With the Faded Label

lore.common: Holds a spice that nobody has used since they bought it.
lore.uncommon: Has a label so faded that the cook sniffs it every time to guess what's inside.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that one sniff makes the whole kitchen sneeze.
lore.epic: Was mistaken for cinnamon, and a whole birthday cake tasted of curry.
lore.legendary: Had a label so faded that nobody knew what it was, but it made the best stew ever.

names.legendary: The Carton That Never Leaked

lore.common: Sits in the fridge door with its spout half open.
lore.uncommon: Gets put back in the fridge with one sip left, so whoever finds it is cross.
lore.rare: Pours so fast that the cereal bowl overflows.
lore.epic: Was opened from the wrong side, and the milk went everywhere.
lore.legendary: Was opened and poured perfectly every morning for a month without a single drip.

names.legendary: The Cocoa That Warmed a Snowstorm

lore.common: Steams in its mug with marshmallows floating on top.
lore.uncommon: Grows a wrinkly skin on top if it is left for a minute, which half the family loves.
lore.rare: Is so warm and sweet that it makes everyone smile on a cold day.
lore.epic: Warmed a whole family after a snowball fight, and everyone wanted seconds.
lore.legendary: Warmed a whole village during a snowstorm, and nobody felt cold at all.

names.legendary: The Cup of Tea That Fixed Everything

lore.common: Steams in the mug and is offered to every visitor before they sit down.
lore.uncommon: Gets left to go cold on the windowsill while its maker answers the door.
lore.rare: Makes every problem seem smaller after the first sip.
lore.epic: Was made for a whole street after a power cut, and everyone felt better.
lore.legendary: Fixed every problem in the family for forty years, one cup at a time.

names.legendary: The Salt That Got Everything Right

lore.common: Is sprinkled on chips, eggs and everything else at the table.
lore.uncommon: Gets spilled and then thrown over a shoulder for luck.
lore.rare: Makes everything taste better, until too much is added.
lore.epic: Was spilled into the soup, and the whole family drank a jug of water.
lore.legendary: Made every meal taste just right for a whole year, and the cook won a prize.

names.legendary: The Shaker That Never Clumped

lore.common: Has little holes on top that get blocked when the salt goes damp.
lore.uncommon: Comes off its lid at the wrong moment and dumps all the salt on the chips.
lore.rare: Shakes so much salt out at once that the dinner is ruined.
lore.epic: Lost its lid at dinner, and the whole plate became a salt mountain.
lore.legendary: Never clumped once in twenty years, even in the dampest kitchen.

names.legendary: The Spices That Travelled the World

lore.common: Fill the kitchen with smells from far-away places.
lore.uncommon: Make everyone sneeze when the jar is opened too fast.
lore.rare: Make every dish taste like an adventure.
lore.epic: Filled the kitchen with a spice cloud so strong that everyone sneezed at once.
lore.legendary: Have travelled from every corner of the world to sit in one kitchen cupboard.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Kept the Plants Happy

lore.common: Sprays a fine mist over the house plants every morning.
lore.uncommon: Sprays water straight at whoever is holding it.
lore.rare: Sprays so far that it hits the cat on the other side of the room.
lore.epic: Was used in a water fight, and every child in the garden was soaked.
lore.legendary: Kept every house plant so happy that they grew taller than the windows.

names.legendary: The Sushi That Went Round Forever

lore.common: Is a little roll of rice and seaweed with something tasty inside.
lore.uncommon: Falls apart when it's dipped in soy sauce for too long.
lore.rare: Turns any meal into a puzzle of chopsticks, soy sauce and one very brave dab of wasabi.
lore.epic: Went round the sushi conveyor so many times that it was given a name.
lore.legendary: Went round the conveyor belt all day without anyone taking it, and the chef took it home.

names.legendary: The Flask Still Hot After a Week

lore.common: Keeps soup hot all morning and pours a little cup from its own lid.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that unscrews into a cup and then refuses to screw back on.
lore.rare: Keeps drinks so hot that the first sip at lunch still makes eyes water.
lore.epic: Was opened on a snowy hilltop picnic, and the steam fogged everyone's goggles.
lore.legendary: Was forgotten in a rucksack for a week and poured out tea that was still too hot to drink.

names.legendary: The Vase That Survived the Football

lore.common: Holds flowers on the windowsill and leaves a ring of water on the wood.
lore.uncommon: Tips over whenever the window is opened on a windy day.
lore.rare: Wobbles so dangerously when anyone walks past that the whole room holds its breath.
lore.epic: Was knocked by a football in the lounge and wobbled for ten seconds before deciding to stay up.
lore.legendary: Survived three footballs, two cats and a toddler, and still holds the flowers every Sunday.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Became a Candle Holder

lore.common: Is tall and dark green with a long neck and a label that peels in the damp.
lore.uncommon: Clinks loudly in the recycling bag all the way to the bottle bank.
lore.rare: Rolls off the table so slowly that everyone has time to watch and nobody catches it.
lore.epic: Was dropped into the bottle bank so loudly that the pigeons flew off the car park.
lore.legendary: Was turned into a candle holder and held a candle every evening for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Can That Sprayed Its Last

lore.common: Psssts when it's pressed and is kept on a high shelf away from small hands.
lore.uncommon: Sputters out its last puff in a sad little cough and then pretends it is still full.
lore.rare: Sprays such a big cloud that the whole room goes misty.
lore.epic: Sprayed so much in one go that the bathroom fogged up like a cloud.
lore.legendary: Lasted so long that it was shaken, sprayed and rattled for a whole year before it was empty.

names.legendary: The Spray That Made It Smell Like Spring

lore.common: Puffs out a smell of pine trees whenever somebody walks past.
lore.uncommon: Puffs at the exact moment someone is walking past, making them jump.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that the whole house smells like a forest.
lore.epic: Puffed so much in a small bathroom that visitors thought they were in a flower shop.
lore.legendary: Made a whole house smell like spring in the middle of winter.

names.legendary: The Almond That Crossed the Sea

lore.common: Is a teardrop-shaped nut with a crunchy bite.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck between teeth after every handful.
lore.rare: Hides in the bottom of the cereal bag and waits for the moment a spoon gets bored.
lore.epic: Was found in a trail mix as the very last nut, and everyone wanted it.
lore.legendary: Was grown in a sunny orchard far away and crossed the sea to land in a lunchbox.

names.legendary: The Bacon That Woke the Whole House

lore.common: Sizzles in the pan and spits a little hot fat at the cook.
lore.uncommon: Spits a speck of hot fat at the cook's wrist the moment they lean in to check.
lore.rare: Smells so good that every person in the house appears in the kitchen.
lore.epic: Sizzled on a Saturday morning, and the whole street woke up hungry.
lore.legendary: Woke the whole house with its smell, and every person came down in their pyjamas.

names.legendary: The Froth That Never Went Flat

lore.common: Has a thick head of foam that leaves a moustache on grown-ups.
lore.uncommon: Spills its foam over the side when it's poured too fast.
lore.rare: Froths so much that the glass is half foam and half drink.
lore.epic: Overflowed its foam all over a harvest festival table, and the tablecloth bubbled.
lore.legendary: Had a head of foam so tall that it stood above the glass like a cloud.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Made the Bathroom Shine

lore.common: Lives under the sink with a child-proof cap and a strong smell.
lore.uncommon: Has a cap that clicks so loudly that everyone knows the bathroom is being cleaned.
lore.rare: Makes a bathroom so clean that the tiles sparkle like a mirror.
lore.epic: Scrubbed the grout so white before a visit that the visitors asked if the bathroom was new.
lore.legendary: Made the bathroom so sparkling that a grandma said it was the cleanest she had ever seen.

names.legendary: The Wash That Made a Mountain of Bubbles

lore.common: Squeezes out a blob of gel that smells of fruit or flowers.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes out far too much when the bottle is nearly empty.
lore.rare: Makes so many bubbles that the shower is full of foam.
lore.epic: Was squeezed too hard, and the whole shower turned into a bubble bath.
lore.legendary: Made a mountain of bubbles so big that it reached the ceiling.

names.legendary: The Cap That Was Always Found

lore.common: Twists off a bottle and rolls under the sofa straight away.
lore.uncommon: Pings off the counter when twisted too hard and lands in the dog's water bowl.
lore.rare: Rolls so far when dropped that nobody can find it.
lore.epic: Rolled under the fridge, and the whole family got down on the floor to look.
lore.legendary: Was lost a hundred times and found every time, which is a record.

names.legendary: The Tea With the Most Pearls

lore.common: Has chewy pearls at the bottom that shoot up the big straw.
lore.uncommon: Has its pearls get stuck in the straw on the last sip.
lore.rare: Shoots pearls up the straw so fast that its drinker gets a surprise.
lore.epic: Was slurped so hard that a pearl shot out of the straw and landed on the table.
lore.legendary: Had so many pearls that it was more pearl than tea.

names.legendary: The Candle That Burned a Whole Winter

lore.common: Flickers in its glass jar and fills the room with a cosy smell.
lore.uncommon: Tunnels down the middle and leaves wax round the edges.
lore.rare: Makes a whole evening feel slower and softer, until somebody blows it out and the spell breaks.
lore.epic: Made a whole evening so cosy that nobody wanted to go to bed.
lore.legendary: Burned slowly through a whole winter, and the house smelled lovely every night.

names.legendary: The Cashew That Was Picked First

lore.common: Is curved like a little moon and is always picked first from the mixed nuts.
lore.uncommon: Disappears from the bowl so fast that only peanuts are left.
lore.rare: Is so popular that everyone hunts for it in the bowl.
lore.epic: Was picked out of a party bowl so fast that the bowl was all peanuts in a minute.
lore.legendary: Was the first nut picked from every bowl at every party for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Chestnut Roasted on a Snowy Night

lore.common: Is shiny and brown and comes out of a spiky green shell.
lore.uncommon: Pops in the fire if nobody remembers to cut a cross in it.
lore.rare: Smells so good when it's roasting that everyone stops at the stall.
lore.epic: Was roasted at a winter market, and the queue went round the square.
lore.legendary: Was roasted on a snowy night, and the whole street gathered round the fire.

names.legendary: The Wing That Needed Ten Napkins

lore.common: Is covered in sticky sauce that ends up on every finger.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a pile of bones on the plate that grows all evening.
lore.rare: Is so saucy that its eater needs a whole pack of napkins.
lore.epic: Was eaten at a game night, and the sofa got a coat of sauce.
lore.legendary: Needed ten napkins and a shower to eat, and was worth every one.

names.legendary: The Chickpeas That Rolled Everywhere

lore.common: Are little round beans that roll across the counter when spilled.
lore.uncommon: Roll off the plate and under the table at every meal.
lore.rare: Roll so far when dropped that they're found weeks later.
lore.epic: Were spilled on the kitchen floor and rolled under every cupboard.
lore.legendary: Rolled so far across the floor that one was found in the garden the next spring.

names.legendary: The Spray That Cleaned the Whole House

lore.common: Sprays a fresh-smelling mist and lives up high where only grown-ups can reach.
lore.uncommon: Sprays sideways when the nozzle isn't turned the right way.
lore.rare: Makes the counter so clean that the dog slips on it.
lore.epic: Cleaned the whole kitchen before a party, and the counter shone like ice.
lore.legendary: Cleaned a whole house in an afternoon, and the windows sparkled in the sun.

names.legendary: The Cocoa That Made Every Winter Better

lore.common: Is a brown powder that turns milk into hot chocolate.
lore.uncommon: Puffs up a little cloud whenever its tin is opened.
lore.rare: Makes everyone sneeze when it's spooned too quickly.
lore.epic: Was spooned too fast, and the whole kitchen got a dusting of cocoa.
lore.legendary: Made every winter better for a whole family, one mug at a time.

names.legendary: The Bag That Smelled Like Morning

lore.common: Has a little valve that puffs out coffee smell when it's squeezed.
lore.uncommon: Spills grounds on the counter every time it's opened.
lore.rare: Puffs its rich smell through the valve every time the cupboard door bumps it.
lore.epic: Was spilled on the floor, and the kitchen smelled like a cafe for a week.
lore.legendary: Smelled so good that it woke up a whole family before their alarms.

names.legendary: The Beans That Woke Up the Office

lore.common: Are shiny brown beans that smell like a cafe.
lore.uncommon: Spill across the counter when the bag is opened too quickly.
lore.rare: Smell so strong that just walking past makes people feel awake.
lore.epic: Were spilled across the office kitchen, and everyone stepped on them for a week.
lore.legendary: Woke up a whole office just by being opened at nine in the morning.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Untangled Everything

lore.common: Makes hair smooth and soft, if it's rinsed out properly.
lore.uncommon: Gets forgotten in the shower, so the hair goes frizzy.
lore.rare: Makes hair so slippery that a hairband slides right off.
lore.epic: Untangled a whole week of knots in one wash.
lore.legendary: Untangled hair so well that a brush went through it in one stroke.

names.legendary: The Cork That Flew the Furthest

lore.common: Plugs up a bottle and pops out with a satisfying sound.
lore.uncommon: Breaks in half when it's pulled out, leaving the rest stuck in the bottle.
lore.rare: Pops out so hard that it flies across the room.
lore.epic: Popped out at a party so hard that it hit the ceiling and bounced into a cake.
lore.legendary: Flew so far when it popped that it landed in the next garden.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Washed Every Sock

lore.common: Glugs into the washing machine and makes the laundry smell fresh.
lore.uncommon: Drips down its side so the bottle is always sticky.
lore.rare: Makes so many bubbles that the washing machine fills with foam.
lore.epic: Was poured too much, and the washing machine foamed all over the kitchen floor.
lore.legendary: Washed every sock in a family of six for a year without running out.

names.legendary: The Soap That Lasted All Year

lore.common: Squeezes into the washing up bowl and makes a mountain of bubbles.
lore.uncommon: Stands on the windowsill with a crust of dried bubbles round its lid.
lore.rare: Makes so many bubbles that the plates disappear underneath.
lore.epic: Made so many bubbles that the washing up turned into a bubble party.
lore.legendary: Lasted a whole year of washing up, and the family thought it was magic.

names.legendary: The Drumstick Every Picnic Fought Over

lore.common: Has a handy bone handle and a crispy coating.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its eater with greasy fingers and a big smile.
lore.rare: Is so tasty that everyone at the picnic wants the last one.
lore.epic: Was dropped at a picnic, bounced once on the blanket and was caught by the dog in mid-air.
lore.legendary: Was fought over at every family picnic for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Filled the House

lore.common: Is a tiny brown bottle with a dropper that lets out one drop at a time.
lore.uncommon: Lets out three drops when only one was wanted.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that one drop fills a whole room.
lore.epic: Was spilled by accident, and the whole house smelled like lavender for a month.
lore.legendary: Filled a whole house with a calm scent from just one drop.

names.legendary: The Supper Eaten on the Seafront

lore.common: Comes wrapped in paper with chips and a fish in crispy batter.
lore.uncommon: Gets its chips stolen by seagulls on the seafront.
lore.rare: Smells so good that the whole street wants some.
lore.epic: Was eaten on the seafront while seagulls lined up like a queue.
lore.legendary: Was eaten on the seafront every Friday for forty years by the same happy family.

names.legendary: The Fillet That Flaked Perfectly

lore.common: Is a flat piece of fish that flakes when it's touched with a fork.
lore.uncommon: Breaks apart in the pan when it's turned.
lore.rare: Flakes so perfectly that it falls apart on the fork.
lore.epic: Was cooked for a family dinner, and every flake was eaten.
lore.legendary: Flaked so perfectly that the chef was given a round of applause.

names.legendary: The Flour That Coated the Kitchen

lore.common: Gets measured out with a mug because the scales are always somewhere else.
lore.uncommon: Leaves white handprints on everything in the kitchen.
lore.rare: Makes such a big cloud when dropped that the whole kitchen turns white.
lore.epic: Was dropped on baking day, and everyone looked like ghosts.
lore.legendary: Coated a whole kitchen in white, and the family baked a cake in the mess.

names.legendary: The Chicken That Crunched the Loudest

lore.common: Has a crunchy coat that flakes off with every bite.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its eater with greasy fingers and a crispy crumb on their chin.
lore.rare: Is so crunchy that the whole room hears every bite.
lore.epic: Was shared out of a bucket at a party, and the bucket was empty in minutes.
lore.legendary: Crunched so loudly at a family dinner that the neighbours came round to see.

names.legendary: The Can That Filled Every Mower

lore.common: Sits in the shed with a long spout and a strong smell, well away from anything hot.
lore.uncommon: Is always nearly empty when the lawnmower needs filling.
lore.rare: Has a spout so long that it's hard to aim straight.
lore.epic: Filled the lawnmower on a sunny Saturday, and the whole street mowed their lawns.
lore.legendary: Kept every lawnmower in the street running for a whole summer.

names.legendary: The Cylinder That Fed Every Barbecue

lore.common: Stands outside by the barbecue, heavy and painted bright orange.
lore.uncommon: Runs out just as the sausages are halfway cooked.
lore.rare: Is so heavy that it takes two people to carry it.
lore.epic: Ran out at a barbecue, and the whole party waited for the new one.
lore.legendary: Fed every barbecue for a whole summer, and the grill cooked a thousand sausages.

names.legendary: The Spray That Made Windows Vanish

lore.common: Sprays blue liquid on windows and squeaks when it's wiped off.
lore.uncommon: Leaves streaks on the window that only show in the sunshine.
lore.rare: Makes windows so clean that birds fly into them.
lore.epic: Cleaned the windows so well that the family walked into the patio door.
lore.legendary: Made the windows so clean that the family thought they had been taken out.

names.legendary: The Soap That Washed a Million Hands

lore.common: Pumps out foam that smells of flowers when it's pressed.
lore.uncommon: Squirts across the sink when it's pumped too hard.
lore.rare: Makes so much foam that hands disappear under it.
lore.epic: Was pumped so many times at a party that the bathroom smelled like a flower shop.
lore.legendary: Has washed so many hands that it now sings a little song with every pump.

names.legendary: The Nut That Fooled a Squirrel

lore.common: Is small and round and hides inside a hard brown shell.
lore.uncommon: Gets buried in the garden by a squirrel that forgets where it put it.
lore.rare: Is so hard to crack that it needs a nutcracker and a strong hand.
lore.epic: Was buried by a squirrel and grew into a tree the next spring.
lore.legendary: Fooled a squirrel into burying it three times in three different gardens.

names.legendary: The Sauce Only the Bravest Tried

lore.common: Comes in a tiny bottle with a warning on the label.
lore.uncommon: Comes out in a big splash when only one drop was wanted.
lore.rare: Is so hot that one drop makes eyes water.
lore.epic: Was tried at a spicy challenge, and everyone drank a glass of milk.
lore.legendary: Was so hot that only one person in the whole town was brave enough to try it.

names.legendary: The Pot That Wrote a Thousand Letters

lore.common: Holds dark blue ink and a little glass well for dipping a pen.
lore.uncommon: Leaves blue fingers on whoever opens it.
lore.rare: Spills so easily that every desk has a blue stain.
lore.epic: Was spilled in a calligraphy class, and every student made a beautiful blot.
lore.legendary: Wrote a thousand letters before it was empty, and every one was posted.

names.legendary: The Can That Saved a Road Trip

lore.common: Is a square can with a handle that sits in the back of the car for emergencies.
lore.uncommon: Clunks around in the boot on every bumpy road.
lore.rare: Makes a car smell so strongly of fuel that the windows stay open the whole drive.
lore.epic: Saved a family road trip when the car ran low in the middle of nowhere.
lore.legendary: Saved a road trip, a camping holiday and a stranded tractor all in one summer.

names.legendary: The Juice That Tasted Like Sunshine

lore.common: Pours bright orange into a glass and has bits that some people don't like.
lore.uncommon: Splashes on the table when it's poured too fast.
lore.rare: Is so fresh that it makes everyone feel like it's summer.
lore.epic: Was spilled at breakfast, and the cat got an orange stripe.
lore.legendary: Tasted so much like sunshine that a whole family felt warmer on a rainy day.

names.legendary: The Skewer That Fed a Barbecue

lore.common: Has chunks of meat and vegetables stacked on a long stick.
lore.uncommon: Spins on the grill so the same side always gets burnt.
lore.rare: Is so tasty that everyone grabs one straight off the grill.
lore.epic: Was grilled at a barbecue, and the queue stretched to the garden gate.
lore.legendary: Held so many chunks on one skewer that it needed two cooks to turn it, one at each end.

names.legendary: The Sauce That Came Out Just Right

lore.common: Sits upside down in the fridge waiting for chips.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to come out until someone slaps the bottom of the bottle.
lore.rare: Comes out all at once in a giant splat.
lore.epic: Splattered all over the table at chip night, and everyone laughed.
lore.legendary: Came out exactly the right amount, which no bottle has ever done.
